receiver_review_prerequisites.known: Root-specified account477439 and UET36005151 are targets only; these four sources contain no Microsoft receipt.
Use the UTC creation/processing timestamps and verify Microsoft reporting timezone/date boundaries. September13 New York is September14 UTC at this transaction time.

A UET page view, active-tag status, aggregated value or configured goal alone cannot establish receipt of this purchase. Match the actual relevant purchase goal/event andUSD111.96; distinguish reported/default currency from raw currency if unavailable.

Private order/transaction identifiers are absent from the permitted sanitized sources. The reported GA4 exact match cannot be transferred to Microsoft. Without a supported private exact comparison, label time/value/basket correlation as a candidate match only.
The four public variant quantities and order amounts are provided. Confirm actual Microsoft item fields when exposed; their absence is an evidence limit, not automatically a broken conversion tag.

receiver_review_prerequisites.need: Sender duplication, consent and paid attribution assessed separately
receiver_review_prerequisites.known: A single downstream reported transaction does not prove one sender event, correct consent ordering, Microsoft click linkage or attributed paid revenue. Those claims require their own evidence.

adverse_interpretation: An apparent MicrosoftUSD111.96 result on the matching reporting day could still be an aggregate/coincidental or deduplicated value. One genuine Shopify order and one GA4 transaction do not prove the Microsoft sender fired correctly, Microsoft caused the sale, or acquisition was profitable. Exact identity, receiver payload scope and attribution must remain separate.
limits: This is a local reconciliation of sanitized source reports, not an independent live replay of Shopify, GA4 or Microsoft.

No new API/browser/Shopify calls, contact, source/canonical changes, consent workaround, test event, purchase or paid action were performed or authorized.
